name: paths-with-spaces
title: Backup script that survives spaces and brackets
prompt:
`backup.ps1 -Source <dir> -Destination <dir>` fails when a folder contains spaces
(e.g. `C:\Users\Dr X\My Docs`) or special characters such as `[ ]` and `'`.

Fix it so that it:
- copies every `.txt` file directly inside `-Source` (not in subfolders) to `-Destination`
- creates `-Destination` if it does not exist
- works with spaces, brackets and apostrophes in both paths
- prints exactly `Copied N files` (N = number of files copied)
It must run on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
